compiled_state.description:
Create plugins/dso/docs/contracts/commit-override-token.md documenting the override token schema.

## Schema to document
JSON fields: {diff_hash, reason, timestamp, attribution}
- diff_hash: sha256sum first 12 chars of git diff --cached output
- reason: user-supplied --reason= argument text
- timestamp: ISO 8601 UTC
- attribution: {skill_name, agent_id} — reserved for future population, null placeholders acceptable now

Storage: single JSON file at $ARTIFACTS_DIR/override.token (overwritten on each dso commit-override invocation)
Lifecycle: created by commit-override.sh; consumed (deleted) by post-commit-override-cleanup.sh after successful commit; NOT consumed by dry-run hook invocations
Log: JSON Lines append to $ARTIFACTS_DIR/commit-overrides.log on each use

## Contract schema compliance
Document MUST pass check-contract-schemas.sh pre-commit hook:
- Open with: # Contract: commit-override-token (level-1 heading)
- Include ## Purpose section with non-empty content

## Classification
UPDATE — documentation artifact, no failing test required

## Files to modify
- plugins/dso/docs/contracts/commit-override-token.md (CREATE)
